description: This file provides utility functions for constructing file paths related to bundled plugins, including methods for constructing paths for plugin root directories, plugin files, directories, distribution paths, and installation specifications. It exports constants representing base directory paths and various functions to generate full paths based on plugin identifiers and relative paths.
